audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A melancholic piano track begins, playing slow, somber chords. A male voice speaks with heavy vocal strain and exaggerated breathiness, mimicking the sounds of someone on their deathbed. He says, 'Zài chǎo, tōngtōng dōu bùyào xiàkè,' his voice trailing off with high tension. (2) A soft digital whoosh effect marks a transition. The same male voice continues, maintaining the strained, dying tone, but the content shifts to beverage ordering instructions: '135 hào de nà yī dān nǎichá yào sān fēn táng, qù bīng...' The piano music remains continuous, providing a humorous contrast between the tragic tone and the mundane dialogue.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a comedic contrast by depicting the 'final words' of people in different professions, showing how their work habits consume them even in a hypothetical deathbed scenario.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The humor relies entirely on the juxtaposition of high-stakes vocal delivery and low-stakes professional dialogue.
